maintenance_led.reason: Sells FortiGate firewalls, security hardware and subscriptions mainly as new purchases and renewals of security services, not repair of installed assets.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are mainly private enterprises, service providers and some government; most revenue is paid by commercial buyers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly organically through FortiGate firewalls, Security Fabric and subscriptions, with only occasional small acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Firewalls and Security Fabric sit in core network security; switching means re-architecture, retraining and risk of exposure.
